instruction: Enable minimal view mode in VLC so the player starts with a compact interface.

parameters.window_name: lecture.pdf — 6.006 Introduction to Algorithms, Lecture 2: Data Structures

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened VLC Tools > Preferences, navigated to Hotkeys tab, searched for 'play', switched to Advanced Preferences, but repeatedly failed to double-click the correct Global column cell for Play/Pause hotkey. Spent all 50 turns unable to set the global hotkey due to imprecise UI clicking.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open VLC menus, navigate Preferences tabs (Interface, Hotkeys, Advanced), use search in hotkey list, type text, switch between Simple and All settings views
metadata.failure_analysis: Model could not precisely target the 'Global' column cell for 'Play/Pause' in the hotkey table. Kept clicking on 'Exit fullscreen' row instead. The hotkey table cells are small and hard to target accurately.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a single checkbox toggle on VLC's Interface Settings page, which the model demonstrated it can navigate to. 'Start in minimal view mode' is a clearly visible checkbox.
metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling 'Start in minimal view mode' checkbox in VLC Interface preferences. Evaluator reads vlcrc config file and checks qt-minimal-view setting equals 1.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config) correctly reads the VLC configuration file (vlcrc) from the VM, which contains the qt-minimal-view setting
Postconfig correctly kills VLC before reading config, ensuring VLC writes its latest settings to vlcrc on exit
Metric (check_qt_minimal_view) correctly parses vlcrc for 'qt-minimal-view=' line and compares against expected value '1' (enabled)
Expected value parameter handling is correct: get_rule returns {'expected_qt_minimal_view': 1} and metric accesses rule['expected_qt_minimal_view'] directly
Complete semantic coverage: instruction requires enabling minimal view mode, evaluator checks exactly qt-minimal-view=1 in vlcrc
Default value of '0' (disabled) in the metric is correct for qt-minimal-view, ensuring proper comparison when the key is not yet in the config
